body.purpose: User and assistant prose in the sidebar.

motion.name: waiting-pulse
motion.purpose: Three 5px dots while the model is loading; delays 0 / 0.15s / 0.3s.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Host-colored action: Send, Keep All, Undo All, Review, Stop.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--vscode-button-background); color: var(--vscode-button-foreground); border: none; padding: 6px 12px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Composer textarea
components.description: Pinned message field; 3 rows, no resize.
components.css: .ds-input-composer { width: 100%; resize: none; color: var(--vscode-input-foreground); background: var(--vscode-input-background); border: 1px solid var(--vscode-input-border, transparent); padding: 8px; font: inherit; } .ds-input-composer:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); }

components.name: User bubble
components.description: Human turn on the input plane.
components.css: .ds-bubble { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vscode-widget-border, transparent); } .ds-bubble-user { background: var(--vscode-input-background); color: var(--vscode-foreground); } .ds-role { display: block; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; margin-bottom: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-bubble p { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Assistant bubble
components.description: Streamed prose on the editor plane.
components.html:
Agent

I'll read the file first.
components.css: .ds-bubble { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vscode-widget-border, transparent); } .ds-bubble-assistant { background: var(--vscode-editor-background); color: var(--vscode-foreground); } .ds-role { display: block; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; margin-bottom: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-bubble p { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Tool row
components.description: Log line for a tool call; dimmer while running.
components.css: .ds-bubble { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vscode-widget-border, transparent); } .ds-bubble-tool { opacity: 0.75; font-family: var(--vscode-editor-font-family); font-size: 12px; } .ds-bubble-tool-running { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-role { display: block; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; margin-bottom: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-bubble p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Review card
components.description: Pending SEARCH/REPLACE review; Keep / Undo / Review.
components.html: Review
components.css: .ds-bubble { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vscode-widget-border, transparent); } .ds-bubble-review { background: var(--vscode-editorWidget-background); color: var(--vscode-foreground); } .ds-role { display: block; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; margin-bottom: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-review-head button { color: var(--vscode-foreground); background: none; border: none; padding: 0; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-review-head button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); } .ds-review-list { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 16px; } .ds-review-file { background: none; border: none; color: var(--vscode-textLink-foreground); cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 0; font: inherit; } .ds-review-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--vscode-button-background); color: var(--vscode-button-foreground); border: none; padding: 6px 12px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); }

components.name: Suggestion row
components.description: @ file complete row on the widget plane.
components.css: .ds-suggest { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 4px; max-height: 160px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--vscode-widget-border, transparent); background: var(--vscode-editorWidget-background); } .ds-suggest-item { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; padding: 4px 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-suggest-item[aria-selected="true"], .ds-suggest-item:hover { background: var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground); }

narrative.overview:
The chat lives inside VS Code. Paint, type, focus rings, and primary buttons are the host's. Palm Agent does not ship a brand palette; it maps roles onto var(--vscode-*) so Dark+, Light+, and custom themes stay coherent.

The layout is a Cursor-like sidebar: streaming prose, dim tool rows, a review card with Keep / Undo / Review. Custom craft is limited to 6px message cards and density. There is no marketing chrome, neon agent skin, or private color system.
keyCharacteristics: Host tokens only — no hardcoded hex
6px cards for messages and review; actions stay native VS Code buttons
Flat surfaces now; shadow only later, and only on hover or focus
Tool rows read as a log (editor mono, 12px); prose uses the workbench UI font

rules.name: The Host Paint Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a hex, OKLCH, or brand accent. If a new surface needs color, pick an existing --vscode-* role.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Prose uses the UI font. Tool traces use the editor font. Do not invert them.

rules.name: The Sidebar Column Rule
rules.body: One column, composer glued to the bottom. Do not add a header brand bar or a second rail.

rules.name: The Resting-Flat Rule
rules.body: At rest, no shadow. A later hover/focus shadow must still use host colors, not a drop-shadow brand glow.

rules.name: The One Radius Rule
rules.body: 6px is the only custom radius. Buttons and the textarea stay square like VS Code.

dos: Do paint with var(--vscode-*) roles already in this file.
Do keep message cards at 6px and host buttons square.
Do treat tool rows as a log (editor font, 12px, reduced opacity).
Do keep the composer at the bottom of a single column.
donts: Don't ship a brand hex, gradient, or illustration in the chat.
Don't add resting box-shadows to bubbles.
Don't invent a display typeface or a header logo bar.
Don't attach file-body chips as a visual pattern (product: @ is path text only).
